published_result: The filled moving-meridian volume limit, exact scalar, normalized profile and preferred-cusp first correction now cover arbitrary fixed trivalent bare components on physical turn edges, in addition to singleton and path-qualified components.
scope_limits: The complete-value theorem remains broader than this moving-meridian theorem.
A component with more than one bare junction and at least one junction of valence greater than three still requires the existing path criterion. Artificial unturned binary resolutions do not qualify.
The knot presentation and sufficiently long signed filling integers are fixed before N tends to infinity. The lower twist threshold is independent of their ratios and of R<1.
Ordinary-color resonances, a fixed M disk and a selected classical geometric A-factor remain open.
